t: Repo Gardening: A Guide to Surgical Git History
s: This technical journal demonstrates practical Git repo gardening for solo developers, focusing on surgically purging unused assets and maintaining a clean, recoverable history through advanced command-line workflows and Conventional Commits.
sub: Surgical Git history cleanup using ripgrep
Implementing Conventional Commits for parsable history
Leveraging Git diff/show for commit analysis
Advanced Git workflows for solo developers
